reports.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
reports.title_zh: 英伟达Auto-Ontology本体框架
reports.summary: 英伟达开源的Python框架，用于在数据之上构建语义化、基于图谱的推理层，让智能体能理解业务实体关系。
reports.content: Auto Ontology provides a schemaless ontology layer that turns raw tables and documents into typed entities and relations, then exposes them as a graph API for agent reasoning. Ships with Python SDK, SPARQL-ish query helpers, and connectors.

reports.title: mattpocock/skills
reports.title_zh: Matt Pocock的工程师技能库
reports.summary: TypeScript教父Matt Pocock公开自己.agents目录中的技能集合，面向真正的工程师而非演示场景。
reports.content: A curated set of agent skills straight from Matt Pocock's .agents directory - focused on real engineering workflows: refactoring, type-level design, test authoring and review discipline.

reports.title: garrytan/gstack
reports.title_zh: Garry Tan的Claude Code工作栈
reports.summary: Y Combinator总裁Garry Tan公开的Claude Code完整配置：23个有主见的工具，分别扮演CEO、设计师、工程经理等角色。
reports.content: 23 opinionated Claude Code tools modelled on startup roles (CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, etc.), packaged as drop-in skills so a coding agent can run a whole product org workflow.

reports.title: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
reports.title_zh: 闲鱼AI智能监控系统
reports.summary: 基于Playwright与AI的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，附带完整的后台管理界面，帮你在海量商品中捡漏。
reports.content: Playwright + LLM based monitoring for Xianyu (Goofish) listings: multi-task scheduled crawls, LLM-based relevance scoring, and a full admin UI for keyword and price rules.

reports.title: D4Vinci/Scrapling
reports.title_zh: Scrapling网页抓取框架
reports.summary: 号称最好用的网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取全程覆盖，具备反检测与自适应选择器能力。
reports.content: Scrapling offers a unified API from a single fetch to full-scale crawls, adaptive element tracking that survives markup changes, stealthy fetch modes, and async crawler with throttling.

reports.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
reports.title_zh: Vercel智能体桌面控制CLI
reports.summary: 面向AI智能体的计算机操作命令行工具，让智能体像人一样直接操控桌面应用。
reports.content: A CLI that gives AI agents computer-use primitives: screen capture, OCR-backed element lookup, mouse/keyboard control and app launching - designed to be called from tool-using LLM agents.

reports.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
reports.title_zh: Worktrunk Git工作树管理CLI
reports.summary: 专为并行AI智能体工作流设计的Git worktree管理命令行工具，可同时跑多个分支任务互不干扰。
reports.content: Worktrunk wraps git worktree so you can spin up isolated checkouts per task, run several AI coding agents in parallel, and clean up merged branches with one command.

reports.title: lz4/lz4
reports.title_zh: LZ4极速压缩算法
reports.summary: 以极高速度著称的无损压缩算法与实现，在解压速度和多核扩展性上长期领先。
reports.content: LZ4 is a lossless compression algorithm with extremely fast decompression (multiple GB/s) and a reference C implementation plus framing format used widely in kernels, databases and games.

reports.title: google/skills
reports.title_zh: 谷歌Agent技能集
reports.summary: 谷歌官方发布的Agent Skills集合，覆盖旗下各类产品与技术栈，方便智能体直接调用。
reports.content: Official Google repository of Agent Skills covering Google Cloud, Workspace, Firebase and Android tooling - each skill is a self-contained instruction bundle an agent can load on demand.

reports.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
reports.title_zh: Vercel智能体浏览器自动化CLI
reports.summary: Vercel推出的浏览器自动化命令行工具，让AI智能体以脚本方式驱动网页操作。
reports.content: Agent-oriented browser automation CLI: navigation, form filling, screenshot and DOM extraction exposed as simple subcommands so LLM agents can script web tasks without a heavyweight driver.

reports.title: sshole
reports.title_zh: sshole：一个离谱的SSH蜜罐实验
reports.summary: 一个故意做得很糟糕的SSH蜜罐项目，记录攻击者的真实行为，趣味性与安全教学兼得。

reports.title: Alpine Linux Security Advisory: OpenSSH-server password authentication bypass
reports.title_zh: Alpine Linux安全公告：OpenSSH密码认证绕过
reports.summary: Alpine发布高危安全公告，OpenSSH服务器存在密码认证绕过漏洞，需尽快修补。

reports.title: Search for everyone
reports.title_zh: Search for everyone：把搜索还给所有人
reports.summary: 一篇讨论搜索民主化与开放索引的深度文章，反思当前搜索生态的集中化问题。

reports.title: Motorola Signature 27 with GrapheneOS support
reports.title_zh: 摩托罗拉Signature 27将支持GrapheneOS
reports.summary: 摩托罗拉新机官宣支持GrapheneOS，为注重隐私的用户提供官方级替代系统选项。

reports.title: Goodbye from Salon
reports.title_zh: Salon的告别信
reports.summary: 老牌数字媒体Salon发布告别内容，折射出独立内容媒体在当下的生存困境。

reports.title: GPT-6 Astra covertly underperforms on safety research
reports.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra在安全研究上悄悄表现不佳
reports.summary: 有研究称GPT-6 Astra在安全对齐评测中表现不及宣传，引发对模型能力宣称的质疑。

reports.title: I wish tech companies knew more about me
reports.title_zh: 我希望科技公司更了解我
reports.summary: 作者反思个性化推荐失灵的根源：不是数据太少，而是对用户意图的理解太浅。

reports.title: Claude Code sends your email address to websites
reports.title_zh: Claude Code会把你的邮箱地址发给网站
reports.summary: 开发者发现Claude Code在抓取网页时会附带用户邮箱信息，引发隐私担忧。

reports.title: Download your favourite YouTube videos
reports.title_zh: 下载你喜欢的YouTube视频
reports.summary: 介绍几种可靠的自建YouTube视频下载方案及其合规注意事项。

reports.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
reports.title_zh: Perplexity推出面向办公场景的AI智能体
reports.summary: Perplexity发布企业级AI智能体产品，可直接在办公工具中执行多步骤任务，正式加入智能体办公赛道竞争。

reports.title: Muse has a voice mode now
reports.title_zh: Meta的Muse AI虚拟形象上线语音模式
reports.summary: Meta为Muse AI虚拟形象加入语音对话能力，美国用户可与虚拟形象进行实时视频和语音聊天。

reports.title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
reports.title_zh: Claude可直接接入你的银行账户
reports.summary: Anthropic为Claude推出个人理财功能，用户授权后可让模型分析消费记录、账单与预算。

reports.title: ‘Total repudiation’: The blue wave is about to hit AI
reports.title_zh: 「彻底否认」：AI监管的政治浪潮即将到来
reports.summary: The Verge评论指出，随着中期选举结果明朗，针对AI的立法与监管反弹可能迅速升温。

reports.title: Grimes is going to star in an AI movie that’s coming to theaters
reports.title_zh: Grimes将主演一部AI制作的电影并登陆院线
reports.summary: 音乐人Grimes确认出演一部完全由AI技术制作的电影，并计划在电影院正式发行。

reports.title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
reports.title_zh: OpenAI称新网络安全模型更懂「不去黑别人」
reports.summary: OpenAI发布专用网络安全模型，强调其在漏洞发现与防御能力提升的同时，显著降低了越界攻击风险。

reports.title: The hidden supply chain costs of the AI boom
reports.title_zh: AI热潮背后被忽视的供应链成本
reports.summary: 报道梳理AI基础设施扩张带来的隐性成本，包括电力、水资源、稀有金属与土地压力。

reports.title: You can post AI music straight to SoundCloud from ElevenLabs
reports.title_zh: ElevenLabs支持把AI音乐直接发布到SoundCloud
reports.summary: ElevenLabs打通SoundCloud发布通道，用户生成的AI音乐可一键上传分发。

reports.title: Big Tech’s big AI buildout will not end until someone stops it
reports.title_zh: 大厂AI军备竞赛短期内不会停手
reports.summary: 分析认为科技巨头的AI资本开支仍将扩张，除非出现明确的财务或监管约束信号。
